caption: The drawing features a side view of a horse in motion, with its left front leg and right hind leg raised, while the other two legs are positioned on a base. The horse's body is brown with shades of green, blue, and reddish tones scattered throughout, creating a patina-like effect. The mane is depicted with darker brown or black streaks and has wavy lines, and the tail is curved upward and to the right, also showing some lighter streaks. The horse is attached to a horizontal base by two vertical supports, one beneath its chest and the other beneath its right hind leg. The overall composition places the horse centrally on a light beige or off-white background with some portions cut off at the top right and bottom left corners, possibly from the paper or mounting.
title: Small Metal Weather Vane
